content_units: For   MXN 18,000   over 10 days, the cheapest pure option is   paying everything by credit card   at   17.10 MXN/USD   with no foreign transaction fee.
Formula: `USD cost = \frac{\text{MXN spending}}{\text{MXN per USD}} + \text{fixed fees}`
Strategy   Rate / Fees   USD Needed for MXN 18,000   Extra Fees   Total Effective Cost
All card   17.10 MXN/USD, no fee   18,000 / 17.10 =   USD 1,052.63       USD 0.00       USD 1,052.63
Two ATM withdrawals for all cash   16.85 MXN/USD, USD 4 each   18,000 / 16.85 =   USD 1,068.25       USD 8.00       USD 1,076.25
Airport exchange for all cash   16.20 MXN/USD, no fee   18,000 / 16.20 =   USD 1,111.11       USD 0.00       USD 1,111.11
- Card saves   USD 58.48   vs airport exchange
- ATM-only saves   USD 34.86   vs airport exchange
Best Mix for a 10-Day Mexico Trip
Use card for most spending, and withdraw a small amount of cash once for cash-only places.
- Mexico still has some cash-only use cases: tips, small taquerias, markets, buses, and small shops.
- Avoiding   two   ATM withdrawals reduces fixed fees.
- One ATM withdrawal for cash:   MXN 3,600   → 3,600 / 16.85 =   USD 213.65
That is only about   USD 7.13 more   than all-card, while giving useful cash on hand.
If you want extra buffer cash
This is still much better than doing all spending as cash.
- ATM plan assumes exactly   two withdrawals   for the all-cash scenario.
- Split recommendation assumes   one ATM withdrawal   to minimize fixed fees while keeping some cash available.
